cases.expected: A recoverable text brief remains staged through early workspace loading and clears only at a durable build boundary.
Build-owned CourseGraph enrichment completes under the original approval while a later map edit still invalidates authority.
Weekly quizzes retain exact coverage and item counts without applying those lesson-scoped rules to a cumulative exam.
Blueprint lesson rows and Project actions remain within 320 px and 390 px viewports without document overflow.
A fresh approved package completes every material family, exposes an accessible Agent input, and presents a calm export-ready surface.

boundary: The benchmark measures bounded recovery, approval lineage, deterministic assessment validation, viewport geometry, and one fresh browser package. It does not measure universal teaching quality, factual correctness, instructor approval, accessibility certification, or classroom outcomes.
